title: Allen Klein’s ABKCO sues John Lennon | 1973
content:
A lawsuit against John Lennon was served on 6 July 1973 by Allen Klein’s company ABKCO.

Lennon, along with George Harrison and Ringo Starr, had parted company with Klein earlier in the year. Similar lawsuits were also filed against Harrison, Apple Records, and Apple Films around this time.

The lawsuit was filed in the New York Supreme Court. Klein was seeking to recoup money from loans and advances that Lennon had received during the time of Klein’s management. On 25 July Lennon’s attorney requested an extension to answer the complaint, and was given until 4 September to respond.
